edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. In consideration for the releases and other obligations in this Agreement, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [Settlement Amount] within [number] business days after the Effective Date, by a method of payment agreed by the parties in writing.

2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, on behalf of itself and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, successors, assigns, officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives, irrevocably releases and forever discharges Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, successors, assigns, officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives from all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, and obligations, whether known or unknown, that Plaintiff has or may have arising out of or relating to the matters resolved by this Agreement and based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the Effective Date. This release does not extend to claims to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep confidential the terms of this settlement and shall not disclose them except to their respective attorneys, accountants, insurers, and other professional advisers who are informed of the confidential nature of the information; as required by law, regulation, court order, or governmental authority; or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party required to make a disclosure shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.
